concerns.text: Tasks T051-T054 (WYSIATI Extension) are present but the Spec (FR-004) and Plan ('Notes on Removed Content') explicitly define the outcome as 'belief_rating' only and state that WYSIATI metrics were removed. These tasks attempt to implement unapproved scope (confidence_rating, response_latency) not defined in the spec, creating a direct conflict where the task list mandates work the spec forbids.

Task T004b (Extract Empirical Outcome) is tagged [US1] but the Spec (US-2) defines 'belief_rating' extraction as part of the regression analysis context (US-2). While data extraction is foundational, the specific tag [US1] may misalign with the Spec's grouping of 'belief_rating' under US-2. More critically, T004b is listed in Phase 2 but depends on T005 (Data Fetch) which is also in Phase 2; the dependency chain is valid, but the task description for T004b explicitly raises 'DataMissingError' if 'belief_rating' is missing, which is a valid check, yet the task is not clearly linked to the specific FR-004 requirement for the outcome variable in the task description text.

Task T024 (Regression Analysis) implements the mixed-effects model but the task description does not explicitly state that the Holm-Bonferroni correction (FR-007) is applied to the *interaction term* p-values specifically, which is required by SC-004. The task mentions 'all p-values' but lacks the explicit linkage to the three-way interaction term required by the spec's success criteria.

The 'Notes' section at the end of the file contains contradictory statements: one bullet says 'Phase 5b (WYSIATI Extension) has been REMOVED' and another says 'T051, T052, T053, T054 have been ADDED to Phase 5b'. This internal contradiction in the task document itself creates ambiguity about whether these tasks should exist.
